events.verdict: Brooks (HOU) briefly grasps and releases Porzingis's (BOS) leg during the screen. Porzingis is not dislodged from his position as a result of the contact.
Eason (HOU) briefly grasps and releases Porzingis's (BOS) shorts during the rebound.
Holiday (BOS) firms up in a screening position in Thompson's (HOU) path and the contact as Thompson attempts to move around the screen is marginal.
Sengun (HOU) moves alongside of Tatum's (BOS) path to the basket and as Tatum braces himself before the shot attempt the contact is marginal.
Eason (HOU) legally contests Brown's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Brown (BOS) reaches for the loose ball and the contact with Eason's (HOU) head during the rebound is marginal.
VanVleet (HOU) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away from Brown (BOS). The contact with Brown's arm prior to the contact to the ball is marginal.
Eason's (HOU) arm is not in a legal vertical position when he makes contact to Brown's (BOS) arm, affecting his driving shot attempt.
Thompson (HOU) moves alongside Tatum's (BOS) path and legally defends the driving shot attempt.
Kornet (BOS) commits a take foul on Thompson (HOU).
Thompson (HOU) places his off-arm against Brown (BOS) and as he releases from the contact, Brown's momentum carries him forwards.
VanVleet (HOU) avoids any contact with Pritchard (BOS) during his shot attempt.
